digest.component_or_area: LLM configuration and model class resolution
propositions: Three separate code paths (verify.py, completion.py, code-review.yaml) independently resolve the verifier model using equality tests against default_model, causing non-default model choices to silently bypass the standard class downgrade.
The code-review verify step declares no model key and runs at cfg.model (frontier), defeating both the intended downgrade to standard and the temperature:0 determinism setting that depends on it.

The verifier paths must consolidate on a single reserved-word vocabulary resolved through model_classes.resolve_model_string, distinguishing operator overrides (class config) from provider changes (model id), to prevent the split-brain regression.
resolve_model must lazily import model_classes to resolve class names at step invocation time (avoiding a circular import) while preserving byte-identical behavior for literal model ids.
